title: xmlread
summary: Read XML text into a lightweight DOM-compatible object.

gpu_support.notes: Host-side compatibility builtin; GPU-resident inputs are gathered before execution.

description: Reads an XML file into a lightweight DOM-compatible document object with a parsed document element, attributes, child nodes, text content, and malformed-tag validation.
behaviors: Parses XML text from the active RunMat filesystem provider and rejects malformed XML with mismatched, unterminated, or missing root tags.
Returns an org.w3c.dom.Document-compatible object with Filename, Text, DocumentElementName, and DocumentElement properties.
DocumentElement is an org.w3c.dom.Element-compatible object exposing NodeName, TagName, TextContent, Attributes, and ChildNodes properties.
This is a lightweight DOM compatibility layer; Java method dispatch is not yet a full W3C DOM implementation.
